ce.reduction: mean over pixels with label != ignore_index
ce.precision: logits.float() before cross_entropy, including outside autocast

dice.averaged_over: images whose valid GT contains at least one defect pixel

score_definition.mask_values: 0 background, 1 defect, 255 ignored; other original IDs must first be binarized
score_definition.valid_pixels: 255 excluded from confusion counts and every foreground-area denominator; all-ignore sample rejected
score_definition.gt_source: Dataset original_mask (never the 512 label resized back up)
restore: bilinear valid box -> orig_h x orig_w, align_corners=False
score_definition.confusion: int64 TP/FP/FN/TN summed over images, divided once
score_definition.normal_image_fp: sum(FP) / sum(valid non-255 pixels of normal images)
score_definition.per_image: IoU/Dice are null when GT and prediction are both empty
score_definition.macro: anomaly images only, averaged over images where the value is defined
score_definition.rejected: flipped evaluation samples by default (baseline flip='none')
score_definition.flip_variant: accept_flipped=True explicitly opts into a different protocol; original mask must match transformed coordinates

padding_does_not_affect_loss.resolution: logits share the label resolution, so ignore is exact

padding_lowres_inner_rows.note: rows 0..9 of a 128 grid map to canvas rows 0..39, fully inside the 61-row pad

all_ignored_batch.message: batch has no valid pixel (every label is 255); CE would be 0/0 = NaN. Refusing instead of returning a silent NaN loss.

batch_split_equivalence.caveat: equal only because both halves have the same valid-pixel count and both contain foreground

all_background_prediction.precision_na: model predicted no foreground pixel at all

normal_false_positive.recall_na: ground truth has no foreground pixel in this set

all_ignored_original_mask.message: original mask has no valid pixels for fixture

single_pixel_dropped_at_512.conclusion: original GT records the miss as FN; the resized label silently reports NA
